status: draft 2026-11-18: tasks and repeats are fixed after the screening below, before any run of the series
question: Does gating R3 by Jev keep what B costs down without losing outcomes, and does Jev add anything over simply switching R3 off?

modes.B: Rules Engine b-6 as b-5: R1, R2, R3 block
modes.BJ: R1, R2 block; R3 blocks only when Jev says would_consult at that Stop
modes.B12: R1, R2 block; R3 recorded, never blocks (control: is Jev better than no R3 at all?)

jev.on_error: R3 stands (r3_gate_on_error enforce); every Jev failure is reported and makes the run invalid
jev.asked: synchronously, only at a Stop where R3 would block; at other Stops in shadow mode as before (one Jev context per Stop)
jev.in_cost_and_time: the session wall time includes the wait for Jev; Jev's own cost (jev_usd_est, about $0.0001 per run in b-cost-1) is reported beside the Claude Code cost, not added to it

primary_metric: mean paired difference of claude_code_total_usd for BJ - B and BJ - B12, per task and per cell; every valid run counts, failed or not
secondary: R3 Stops in BJ: how often Jev said yes, and the cost of those consultations
real spend incl. interrupted / invalid runs (pairs report)
design: paired batches with all four modes per repeat, order random inside each repeat (batch --paired --modes A,B,BJ,B12); one task after another on one machine; no parallel sessions

tasks._cells: task type x R3 seen in observe runs (A, 16-18.11); b-cost-1's six tasks are the development set and are not reused

bug_r3.pk-pickle: new (packaging PR #1548, 2026-11-16; upstream fix: 3 source files)
bug_r3.ck-shorthelp: new (click PR #3865, 2026-09-11; upstream fix rewrites the function)

screening.runs: pk-pickle and ck-shorthelp: 2 x A each; one BJ run on pkf-prepared (R3 every time in A) as a live check of the synchronous Jev call
screening.keep_a_new_bug_task_if: valid, solved at least once, R3 triggered at least once in 2; otherwise the bug_r3 cell keeps whichever passes, and the gap is reported

size: 8 tasks x 4 modes x 2 = 64 runs; about 5 h and $25-35 at b-cost-1 rates
caveat: R3 depends on Sonnet's own change, not on the task: a cell is what A showed, not a guarantee; the report gives R3 Stops per run
report: python lab/lab.py pairs --pilot lab/pilots/b-jev-1.json --modes B,BJ (and BJ,B12; A,BJ)
